title: Make construction feedback discoverable and reportable through the existing CLI
problem: The accepted construction REALIZATION path requires a scalar, but the pending-outcomes view omits constructions and the only realize CLI option always emits a forecast list. The operator cannot complete this feedback path through the advertised CLI.
founder_intent_refs: Alfonso's current instructions: Do it; apply the Founder-Intent Collaboration Protocol; Resume.
baseline: Kernel #196 at a1c6dbcb2d5b4f1647b0f3569dbbbdf0aae558d3. Existing record_realization, construction registration and promise predicates, signed REALIZATION dispatch, forecast list behavior, tolerance and scoring are reused unchanged. WMI #45 is a separate handed-off increment.

alternatives.name: List constructions only
alternatives.description: Expose plans without fixing the CLI's scalar/list mismatch.
disadvantages: The suggested forecast-form command would still be rejected for construction outcomes.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Useful only if an already functional alternative scalar reporting interface is supplied.

alternatives.name: Infer scalar from one --value
alternatives.description: Collapse every single observed value to a scalar.
disadvantages: Breaks valid one-step forecasts, whose realization must remain a list.
alternatives.revival_evidence: A separately designed receipt-aware command that can distinguish types without ambiguity and without writing the live ledger.

alternatives.name: Reuse the accepted predicates and add an explicit scalar option
alternatives.description: List pending construction objectives using existing recognition/promise helpers; mutually exclusive --objective-value emits one finite scalar while --value retains forecast lists.
advantages: Closes discoverability and actual signed-command usability together.
No new ledger, authority, contract or scoring rule.
disadvantages: The view still cannot prove an external outcome.
Exact-head integration and independent review remain pending.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Selected as reversible implementation; keep only with body/CLI and compatibility evidence.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Only direct API callers can report construction outcomes; the visible operator feedback list remains incomplete.
disadvantages: Building another learning mechanism would not repair its absent reporting seam.

roles.position: Self-review by the one Codex worker: continue the complete machine after WMI's consumer increment by repairing the next observed learning-input seam.
material_concerns: A component does not close BODY + ORGANS + MIND.

roles.position: Project existing retained receipts and emit the existing signed REALIZATION body; reuse accepted recognition and promise helpers.
material_concerns: No scalar/list ambiguity for one-step forecasts.

roles.position: Attack unsupported/unregistered, tampered, uncertified and objective-less receipts, flag ambiguity, nonfinite values and missing keys.
material_concerns: A pending row cannot certify the world or itself settle competence.
A new CLI form must not bypass founder signing.

roles.position: Expose the named objective, sense, promise, pinned method version, tolerance and actual scalar reporting command in the existing calibration view.
material_concerns: Reading the view must append no events.
Respect the integrator's separate branch and the old #168 CLI seam claim.

roles.position: Self-review only; a founder report remains evidence of the report, not independent world verification.
material_concerns: No real buyer/staffing outcome is supplied.
Existing attribution, tolerance and conflict rules are unchanged.

evidence.finding: Two behavior assertions fail before source edits: a synthetic accepted-shape construction and an actual portfolio construction executed on a temporary body are both absent.

evidence.claim: The existing CLI cannot emit a construction scalar.
evidence.finding: The scalar CLI test fails at argument parsing because the original interface requires repeated --value and has no objective form.

73 passed in 201.40s on Python 3.12.14: pending construction intake, outcome calibration, construction realization/settlement, Goal Gravity and founder tier. Real temporary-body construction, read-only CLI projection and signed scalar reporting exercised.
Restoring only the exact baseline projection produces 1 expected failure and 1 pass; scalar CLI remains functional; production hashes unchanged.

counterevidence.claim: A positive construction-learning dividend has been established.
counterevidence.finding: No. The existing realization test outcomes and this new CLI test outcome are synthetic. Realization intake is a prerequisite, not dividend evidence.

counterevidence.claim: Five perspectives establish independent review or receiver acceptance.
counterevidence.finding: No. All perspectives are one Codex worker's self-review. Independent reviewer unassigned; integration owner has not acknowledged this exact head.

pass_1.intended_outcome: An operator can discover a retained construction's pending objective and report its observed scalar through the existing signed inbox, while forecasts remain compatible.

advantages.statement: Repair the existing path rather than add another learning subsystem.
advantages.amplified_value: Reuse the exact construction and objective predicates accepted by record_realization and its existing authority/scoring path.
Display objective, promise, sense, tolerance and a scalar command that preserves forecast list semantics.

disadvantages.statement: Listing a promise could imply that the world has been verified.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Explicit evidence-limit and authority_created false; no append or settlement in the view; source claims keep their present labels.

disadvantages.statement: Changing --value shape would break one-step forecasts.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep --value as a list; introduce mutually exclusive --objective-value and finite scalar checking.

disadvantages.statement: A new change in shared source could collide with existing integrator work.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Claim exact functions and CLI argument/payload seams; distinguish #168's human-work concern; refresh heads/board and prepare an independent child draft.

comparisons.baseline: The body API already accepts construction scalars; its view and CLI do not expose the complete route.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Listing alone fails practical command execution; scalar-only CLI still leaves plans undiscoverable.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: A receipt-aware form or console could infer expected observations but adds a larger UI/state dependency without improving this bounded path.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Selected projection plus explicit scalar flag, tested from actual construction to signed CLI to retained realization; independent draft only.

rejected_alternatives.name: Generalize realization to all optimization methods
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Changes accepted domain/scoring semantics and is unnecessary for this known path.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A separately owned intent, objective mapping and falsifiable outcome-verification requirement.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the strengthened path for scalar/list ambiguity, bogus receipts, source-label laundering, accidental writing, nonfinite values, missing keys and false learning claims.

new_weaknesses.statement: A command with both forms or a nonfinite scalar might produce ambiguous or invalid signed evidence.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Argparse mutual exclusion, explicit finite scalar check before signing, and tests that refusal leaves the inbox empty.

new_weaknesses.statement: A projection can drift from the actual acceptance predicates.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Reuse _constructed, registration versions/functions and _promise; test the actual body acceptance and preserve existing forecast tests.

new_weaknesses.statement: Pending objective rows and forecast calibration statistics are different evidence types.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Label kind objective and show objective-specific fields; leave forecast calibration statistics unchanged; clarify the existing help text and limitations.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: View states its verification ceiling, reports no authority and is asserted read-only; actual reports still go through the unchanged signed path.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any future consumer treats pending rows as settled or independently verified outcomes.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Explicit mutually exclusive forms preserve a single forecast value as [value] and a construction value as scalar.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: CLI form or realization input contract changes.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Current concern search/claims do not overlap this realization seam; no owner acknowledgment is fabricated and the integrator's branch remains untouched.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Before publication, owner update and exact-head intake.

pass_2.final_design: Extend the existing read-only pending projection to accepted construction objectives and add --objective-value to the existing signed realize CLI. No change to accepted outcomes, verification, permissions, consequence gates, tolerance or competence rules.
